# Growth
**Reimagined**


Date


December 2


Time


2:00–7:00 PM PT


Location


75 Varick Street Rooftop, New York City


Register for the event


The next era starts here


## AI is about to change how your customers choose, buy, and pay.


##### Their trust is the one thing it can’t replace, but earning it is about to get harder.


On December 2, join executives from Truist, Citi, Fiserv, Spotify, and Proof as they share how they keep customers when every product looks alike, prepare for AI that buys on their behalf, decide where speed ends and trust begins, and build teams ready for what’s next.


Featuring Katie Linendoll, a Silicon Valley visionary and Emmy Award winner who has spent two decades telling America what’s coming next in tech. The afternoon concludes with a networking cocktail hour.


## What We’ll Explore


Register for the event


### Customer Growth & Experience


Winning a customer is getting more expensive. Keeping them is where the growth is. See how personalized experiences turn one-off transactions into relationships that last.


### Intelligence & Agentic AI


AI is moving from answering questions to taking action. Discover how intelligent operations are speeding up decisions, lifting productivity, and changing how service gets delivered.


### Trust, Risk & Resilience


Every new capability brings new exposure. Learn how leaders are keeping governance, compliance, cybersecurity, and resilience strong as the rules get more complex.


### Data Platform Transformation


Ambitious AI plans stall on weak foundations. Explore the data platforms and operating models that let growth scale, with banking’s modernization as the case in point.


### Workforce Transformation


New tools bring new roles, new skills, and new ways of working. See how organizations are preparing their people now, rather than after the technology arrives.


### Leadership Action


By 2030, the gap between leaders and the rest will be set by decisions being made today. Leave with a clearer view of the strategies and operating models that will matter.


The next era starts here


## Agenda


2:00–2:30 pm


Opening address


### Welcome to the Concentrix Executive Circle Event


Rising customer expectations. AI-driven disruption. Expanding risk. A workforce in transition. Four forces, one collision, and the operating environment every business runs in has changed. The question is no longer whether to move; it’s whether your customers will still trust you when you do.


In this opening address, we look at where financial services is winning, where it’s exposed, and why the answers travel far beyond banking.


2:00–3:00 pm


Session 1


### The Experience Imperative: How People, Technology, and Connected Experiences Shape the Future of Financial Services


Billions have gone into the customer experience. The employee experience got what was left. Now that the gap is showing up in productivity, innovation, and performance, leaders are looking for ways to close it, fast.


Hear how a leading technology company is building the workplace of the future, accelerating adoption, and connecting people across every boundary, so the experience inside finally matches the one outside.


Moderator


**Katie Linendoll**


GVP, Strategy & Business Operations, Concentrix


Panelist


**Technology Leader**


BFSI


2:00–3:00 pm


Session 2


### Where Will Financial Services Find Its Next Growth Engine?


As growth becomes harder to find, organizations are exploring other ways to achieve it: partnerships, ecosystems, intelligent technology, and importantly, the people who connect them.


Join us as leaders from Fiserv, DUB, Bernstein Wealth Management, and Concentrix discuss how financial institutions can expand beyond traditional models while bringing the entire workforce with them.


Moderator


**Tom McCormick**


Global Operations & CX Executive | Strategic Advisor | Enterprise Transformation & Global Sourcing


Panelist


**Guy Bourgault**


Head of Agentic Services, Concentrix


Panelist


**Mike Leary**


VP, CX Insights, Huntington Bank


Panelist


**Amanda Wiltshire-Craine**


SVP, Head of Operations at Financial Solutions, Fiserv


Panelist


**Brett Chereskin**


COO, DUB


3:30–3:45 pm


Intermission


### Break


A short pause to connect, recharge, and continue the conversation.


3:45–4:15 pm


Session 3


### Know Your Agent: Building Trust in Agentic Commerce


As AI agents increasingly act on behalf of consumers and businesses, financial institutions and merchants face a new trust challenge: establishing who an agent represents, what it is authorized to do, and whether a particular transaction falls within that authority.


This session explores how customer verification, agent identity and authorization, fraud prevention, and third-party governance must work together to enable agentic commerce. Leaders will discuss what institutions need to consider supporting in a future of legitimate agent activity—and how responsibility should be established when something goes wrong.


Moderator


**Shy Daraeikia**


Risk and Compliance Practice Lead, North America


Panelist


**Jeffrey Bashore**


Financial Crimes Executive


Panelist


**Tim Carbery**


Managing Partner at Castle Hill, a Concentrix company


Panelist


**Adam Lemmon**


VP, Partnerships — Identity, Agentic Commerce & Bitcoin, Proof


Panelist


**Ed Hartigan**


Director, Trust and Safety


4:15–5:00 pm


Session 4


### Women Leading the Next Era of Business: Building the Financial Services Organization of the Future


What can leaders across industries learn from the transformation of financial services? As AI, customer expectations, and workforce needs reshape the sector, leadership must evolve with them.


Hear how women leaders are navigating transformation, developing the next generation of talent, and building resilient organizations ready for what comes next.


Moderator


**Katie Linendoll**


Host and Moderator


Panelist


**Kathryn Harrison**


GVP, Strategy & Business Operations, Concentrix


Panelist


**Sherry Graziano**


EVP, Head of Digital, Client Experience and Marketing, Truist


Panelist


**Misty Stiers**


SVP, Head of Ethics and Responsible Experiences, Citi


Panelist


**Amanda Wiltshire-Craine**


SVP, Head of Operations at Financial Solutions, Fiserv


Panelist


**Sally Tonel**


Global Head of Customer Service, Spotify


5:00–7:00 pm


Reception


### Networking Reception


Connect with fellow leaders over cocktails and hors d’oeuvres, exchange perspectives, and build new relationships. Continue the conversations shaping the future of business, including financial services, and explore the challenges and opportunities shared across industries.


## Why Attend


## 01


### Gain Strategic Perspective


Explore how leaders across banking, fintech, and insurance are responding to rapidly changing market conditions.


## 02


### Explore Actionable Innovation


Discover how organizations are applying AI, data, and automation to improve customer outcomes, reduce complexity, and drive measurable business value.


## 03


### Learn from Industry Peers


Exchange practical insights and lessons learned with fellow senior executives facing similar challenges and opportunities.


## 04


### Shape the Future of Business


Contribute to conversations about the capabilities and leadership strategies required for success through 2030 and beyond.


Register for the event


## Meet the Speakers


Additional speakers and panelists will be announced as the event approaches.


Panelists & Moderators


#### Katie Linendoll


Host & Moderator


Katie is an Emmy Award-winning TV personality, national consumer technology expert, emcee, and keynote speaker. For nearly two decades, she has been a trusted technology contributor to the TODAY Show, with an extensive media career spanning ESPN, The Weather Channel, SiriusXM, A&E, The Wall Street Journal, Sports Illustrated, and Popular Science. Named a Silicon Valley Visionary, she combines deep technology expertise with high-energy storytelling to help audiences understand what is next in AI, innovation, and consumer technology.


#### Kathryn Harrison


Global VP, Strategy & Business Operations, Concentrix


Kathryn is a global business leader and serial entrepreneur who leads the Global Product Organization at Concentrix. Before joining Concentrix, she held leadership roles at IBM and GLG, helped lead IBM Blockchain, and built and sold a software company. Her career spans high-impact work across Asia, Europe, Australia, and the U.S., advising governments and Fortune 100 firms along the way.


#### Tom McCormick


Global Operations & CX Executive and Strategic Advisor


Tom is a global operations and customer experience executive with more than 30 years of leadership experience across financial services, technology, and business process outsourcing. During 16 years at Capital One, he helped shape global CX and operations strategy. Today, he advises organizations on global sourcing, enterprise readiness, strategic growth, and AI-enabled operational transformation.


#### Quinten Hout


Global VP, Risk & Compliance Practice, Concentrix


Quinten has more than 15 years of risk and compliance experience. A technologist by background, he built and sold an FCC SaaS company and led global financial crime teams serving major banks. At Concentrix, he leads a practice of more than 15,000 professionals supporting over 75 clients across 100+ countries.


#### Jeffrey Bashore


Financial Crimes Executive


Jeff is a financial crimes executive with more than 24 years leading fraud, anti-money laundering, and claims operations at major U.S. financial institutions. Most recently, he served as SVP and Head of Member Protection at USAA. He previously led Fraud Prevention and Detection at Bank of America and spent 16 years at Citi.


#### Adam Lemmon


Financial Crimes Executive


#### Sherry Graziano


Head of Client Experience and Digital, Truist


Sherry leads enterprise client experience strategy and the digital platforms, products, and experiences that help more than 14 million Truist clients manage their financial lives. Her organization advances personalization, AI-enabled experiences, and open banking to make banking easier and more intuitive.


#### Amanda Wiltshire-Craine


SVP, Head of Operations, Financial Solutions at Fiserv


Amanda brings an operations leadership perspective to the conversations on new growth models, workforce transformation, and building financial services organizations ready for what comes next.


#### Misty Stiers


SVP, Head of Ethics and Responsible Experiences, Citi


Misty is a visionary executive leader with more than 25 years of experience transforming organizations through culture-first design, radical inclusion, and cross-functional collaboration. A patent-holding innovator and award-winning author, she brings equal fluency in boardroom strategy and hands-on creative execution.


#### Guy Bourgault


Head of Agentic Services, Concentrix


Guy has spent more than 20 years helping organizations design, build, and run experiences. He now leads Agentic AI Services and Solutions globally for Concentrix, envisioning the future of work with humans and AI.


## Let’s meet at the top


From sessions featuring some of the world’s best brands to insights from the top voices in tech, this Circle event is one you can’t afford to miss.
